_notice: Screen predicates authored for Ubra from live captures of whipcode v1.0.0 (darwin-arm64) driven against Ubra's fake OpenAI-compatible API, cross-checked against the TUI source at context-labs/whip 88764670 (internal/tui: footerLeft/footerRight in opencode.go, syncInputPlaceholder in tui.go, permView/thinPermissionKey in permission.go/client.go, questionRows in question.go, the provider picker). The agent capability block is Ubra's own.

setup.installHint: Install the standalone WhipCode CLI with its official installer; it lands in ~/.local/bin.
setup.signInHint: Run whipcode and pick a provider, or run whipcode auth.

agent._resumeNotice: No resume on purpose. whipcode --resume needs an id (or unique prefix) that whipcode mints itself and keeps only in its daemon's SQLite store (~/.whipcode/runtime-v2/sessions.db); there is no flag to choose the id at launch and no continue-latest flag, and the only place the id surfaces is the exit line 'session <id> - resume with: whipcode --resume <id>'. Ubra has no way to learn that id today, and guessing the newest session would resume another tab's conversation, so an exited WhipCode tab is not resumable.
agent._promptNotice: Ubra types the initial prompt into the composer like every screen agent; whipcode's own 'whipcode up <words>' launch form is not used.
agent._envNotice: WHIP_DESKTOP_ASKPASS=1 turns the whipcode binary into WhipCode Desktop's SSH askpass helper (cmd/whip/main.go), so an inherited WHIP_DESKTOP_* must never reach a fresh agent. WHIPCODE_HOME and WHIP_THEME are the user's own settings and are deliberately kept.
agent._approveNotice: The permission dialog takes 'a' as allow once and Esc as reject without a reason (thinPermissionKey). Both are sent as raw keys: a bracketed paste is not a key press in the dialog.

rules._notice: First run opens the provider picker over the composer; typed text would land in its search box, so it waits for the user rather than reading as idle.
While a turn runs the footer's left side is the ⬝■ spinner plus 'esc interrupt' (or 'esc again to interrupt' after one Esc).

when.contains: busy — enter steers the running turn

rules._notice: The footer's right side ('ctrl+r repl  ctrl+p commands', or '/connect providers  ctrl+p commands' before a provider exists) is always drawn; the working rules above outrank it while a turn runs.
